accountConnect.account: Ukuphequlula komphakathi akudingi i-akhawunti. Xhumanisa i-akhawunti yakho ye-DeHub ukuze uphathe iphrofayili yakho futhi udale noma ushicilele okuqukethwe.
accountConnect.body: Xhumanisa i-akhawunti yakho ukuze uphathe iphrofayili yakho, ushicilele okuthunyelwe futhi udale okuqukethwe usuka engxoxweni. Ukuxhumana kuphela phakathi namahora angama-24. Unganqamula ukuxhumana nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.
accountConnect.failed: Kuhlulekile ukuqedela ukuxhumana. Zama ukungena ngemvume futhi.
accountConnect.generate: Khiqiza imidiya usebenzisa izikweletu zakho, izinkokhelo eziqinisekisiwe noma izithombe zamahhala ezifanelekile
accountConnect.generatePrompt: Ngikhombise amamodeli ezithombe ze-DeHub futhi ucaphune isithombe ngaphambi kokusikhiqiza.
accountConnect.intro: Phequlula i-DeHub ku-ChatGPT, noma xhumanisa i-akhawunti yakho ukuze ubuyekeze iphrofayili yakho, ushicilele okuthunyelwe futhi usebenzise i-Creator Studio. Engeza i-https://dehub.io/mcp njengesixhumi se-OAuth sezilawuli ze-akhawunti.
accountConnect.libraryPrompt: Ngikhombise izimpahla zakamuva emtatsheni wami wezincwadi woMdali we-DeHub.
accountConnect.profile: Hlela iphrofayili yakho, izithombe nezilungiselelo zobumfihlo
accountConnect.profilePrompt: Buyekeza i-bio yami ye-DeHub ibe: Umdali ozimele owenza amafilimu nomculo.
accountConnect.read: Funda i-akhawunti yakho, okuthunyelwe, izaziso kanye nomtapo wezincwadi woMdali
accountConnect.social: Shicilela okuthunyelwe namazwana, landela abantu futhi ulondoloze amabhukumaka
accountConnect.step: Ezilawulweni ze-akhawunti, engeza i-https://dehub.io/mcp njengesixhumi se-OAuth, ngena ngemvume ku-DeHub futhi ubuyekeze izimvume ngaphambi kokuvumela ukufinyelela.
accountConnect.title: Xhuma i-akhawunti yakho ye-DeHub
accountConnect.what: Phequlula okuthunyelwe komphakathi namaphrofayili. Ngokuxhumeka kwe-akhawunti ye-OAuth, phatha iphrofayili yakho nobumfihlo, shicilela okuthunyelwe namazwana, landela abantu, funda izaziso, londoloza amabhukumaka futhi ukhiqize izithombe, ividiyo, umsindo nezimpahla ze-3D. Ukukhiqiza kusebenzisa imithetho yokukhokha ekhona ye-DeHub.

copy.a443d689e241: Izithombe ezinemininingwane kanye nokulandela imiyalo okuthembekile
copy.a44e2be74d7d: Dala futhi uhlanganise izifundo ezivela ezithombeni zesinkomba
copy.a61d44ba33d5: Unina wazo zonke izinkundla. Dayisa njengomuntu ohamba ngesikhathi ngezinkulungwane zezikrini. Jabulela okuphakelayo okubukhoma okuvela ku-Binance, Dexscreener nanoma yini oyifunayo kusukela kumavidiyo, kumathebhu esiphequluli nakho konke okuphakathi.

copy.a9805864ceb9: Okuthunyelwe okuqukethe isithombe esisodwa noma ngaphezulu. Izithombe zigcinwa ku-chain njengama-NFT anenombolo eyingqayizivele ye-Token ID.
copy.ae644a180614: Iziqondiso ezinde, umbhalo wezilimi eziningi, nokuhlela okugcina umazisi
copy.b17c87d6ac6b: Ayikwazanga ukugcina uchungechunge lokuphosta. Sicela uzame futhi.
copy.b2f1d1d5d653: Ukunyakaza okunesitayela ngomsindo wemvelo neziqeshana ezinde
copy.b3d0998cd00a: Siyabonga — omunye umbukeli ovumayo uzokwenza ukuthi ikhishwe bukhoma
copy.b8c339f21031: I-ByteDance flagship — kuthatha iminyaka engu-30, ukubambelela okusheshayo okungcono kakhulu
copy.ba5680fcdd10: Shintshanisa izinhlamvu, imikhiqizo noma indawo esiqeshini sakho usebenzisa izithombe ezifika kwezine
copy.ba9cdea7f89a: Abanikazi bephosti bangafihla iphosti kokuphakelayo komphakathi (futhi bayibonise futhi) kumenyu yezinketho zephosti. Iphosti efihliwe ibonakala kumnikazi wayo, ephawulwe nge-chip Efihliwe.

copy.c75004c6a69c: Ihumusha umbhalo okuthunyelwe, ama-bio, namazwana olimini oluthandayo. Uhlelo lokusebenza luthola ulimi lwakho ngokuzenzakalelayo noma ungalusetha mathupha kuzilungiselelo (Settings).
copy.ca3f58203ed3: Ividiyo nomsindo ovela embhalweni, izithombe, noma ozimele bokuqala nabokugcina
copy.cde41cf4a6f7: Ukunyakaza kwemvelo, umsindo wendabuko, kanye nokukhipha okufika ku-4K
copy.ce3e77cea442: Ikhombisa ukuthi uyayithanda noma uyavumelana nokuthunyelwe. Kwandisa isikolo sokusebenzisana kokuthunyelwe futhi kusiza ukuthi kubekwe phezulu kokuphakelayo.
copy.ceae840b1f84: Isikhwama semali se-Solana asitholakali — le divayisi ayinalo ukhiye wesikhwama sakho semali. Ngena ngemvume futhi ukuze uwubuyisele.
copy.d3381af6ba42: Inkokhelo ihloliwe — vuselela ukuthunyelwa kwesimo sayo esiqinisekisiwe
copy.d827c0e4fea8: Ividiyo ye-cinematic nomsindo onozimele bokuqala nabokugcina
copy.da90edc91f4a: Ivula ingxenye yokuphawula lapho ungaphendula khona iphosti, ujoyine izingxoxo, futhi uxhumane nabanye abasebenzisi.
copy.ddea42290677: Vota ngokumelene nesiphakamiso sokubusa noma isicelo sesici. Kusiza ukukhombisa ukuphikiswa komphakathi.
copy.de7f043f74a0: Thola okusunguliwe okusha nabasebenzisi. Bhrawuza ngesigaba: amavidiyo, izithombe, ukusakaza bukhoma, nokuningi.
copy.dfc22c6b07ab: Yabelana ngephosti ngaphandle ngelinki, noma ukopishe i-URL yephosti ebhodini lakho ukuze uyithumele kwabanye.
copy.e2741c299499: Multi-shot, ukuvumelanisa komsindo, ukuthathwa kwezithombe okude
copy.e36c6ed4c9a7: Ukuhweba — izindlu, izaphulelo, ukuthengisa — kwenzeka ku-app yewebhu ku-dehub.io, ekhasini ngalinye le-Post Info lephosti. Ukuhweba okuqediwe kuvela kuthebhu ethi Izingxenyana lapha.
copy.e3be5bc43d91: Faka iphosti phezulu kuphrofayili yakho ukuze izivakashi ziyibone kuqala.
copy.e6d650d57b03: Ukuvulwa kwesikhwama se-biometric kulungile kule foni
copy.e7644429fdad: Landela abanye abasebenzisi ukuze ubone amaphosti abo ku-feed yakho. Isibalo sabalandeli bakho siyavela kuphrofayili yakho.
copy.ea5e0b780f7b: Ukuhamba okushelelayo nokunemba okukhulu kwesicelo, akukho msindo
copy.ec9eff0f3f13: Phakamisa izici ezintsha bese uvota emibonweni yomphakathi. Izicelo ezithandwayo zibekwa kuqala ekuthuthukisweni.
copy.f4697afb34f4: Izikhundla zabasebenzisi abaphambili ngokwebhalansi, amathiphu athunyelwe, amathiphu amukelwe, abalandeli, nokunye. Kubuyekezwa ngezikhathi ezithile.
copy.f8d6b01ecf54: Gcina okuthunyelwe ezintweni zakho ozibeke uphawu ukuze ukubuke kamuva. Finyelela kukho konke okuthunyelwe okugciniwe ekhasini le-Bookmarks eliseceleni.

copy.f944da196058: Ukuhlanganiswa okuningiliziwe kanye nokuqondiswa kombala okunembile

copy.fdd9e13d471c: Shintsha isihloko noma incazelo yephosti oyenzile. Ngumsunguli wokuqala kuphela ongahlela amaphosti akhe.
copy.fff1c1ce5e17: I-mesh engcono kunazo zonke, umbhalo noma isithombe
copy.2971f9103f78: Siyabonga ngokusiza ekwenzeni i-DeHub ibe ngcono — into oyicelile manje ibukhoma:
copy.37bd766fa812: Noma ubani angaphakamisa. Abanikeli bayamukela noma benqabe ngesisindo somnikelo wabo obhalisiwe.
copy.3c42f559d757: Ngena ngemvume ukuze umake noma uvote. Ukweqa kusebenza nganoma iyiphi indlela.
copy.4be2a5e0d00a: Ayikho i-escrow. Uma yamukelwe, unamahora angama-72 okudlulisa inkokhelo ukuze iqinisekiswe yi-DAO ngesandla.
copy.4c6c7de71386: Ubufakazi benkokhelo buthunyelwe ukuze buqinisekiswe yi-DAO ngesandla
copy.5b5a9671e539: Skena ku-chain ukuze uthole amadiphozithi angekho
copy.60aac7666712: Umbhalo obhaliwe ubhalwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngokushesha ngemva kokuphostwa kwevidiyo.
copy.7d524ee72c64: Vula okunikezwayo kokuthenga kokuqala noma isicelo sokuchitha.
copy.895bc4b96601: % ukubamba iqhaza · 10% i-quorum · isithombe esikhombisa umnikelo
copy.905392fbed15: Siyabonga ngokusiza ekwenzeni i-DeHub ibe ngcono — {{value1}} izinto ozicelile manje sezibukhoma:
copy.9c7eca1df4f3: Chaza imigomo nokuthi kungani i-DAO kufanele yamukele.
copy.ae4410aa9943: Namathisela noma yiliphi ikhasi le-DeHub — isigaba semibhalo, umvuzo, iphrofayela yakho. Isixhumanisi esingezansi sisabala ukuvakashela kuwena, bese sibayisa khona ngqo.
copy.b5f85f952b0b: Maka isigaba somxhasi noma isingeniso bese wonke umuntu onokweqa evuliwe uzokweqa ngaphezu kwaso. Yiyeke ividiyo idlale — thepha u-Qala lapho iqala bese u-Isiphetho lapho iyeka.
copy.b8cfe281c012: Ukuchithwa okwamukelwe kufakwe emgqeni ukuze kwenziwe ngesandla yi-DAO noma i-multisig. Lesi siphakamiso asiwuhambisi uqobo lwaso umnotho.
copy.f0ed7becd58e: Kuhlulekile ukushintshela ochungechungeni lwakho lokuthumela. Khetha uchungechunge kuzilungiselelo bese uzama futhi.
copy.f3c6dcdb78a4: Abanikeli kuphela abatholakele lapho lesi siphakamiso sivulwa abangakwazi ukuvota.

pacing.help: Iqala ngokuzenzakalelayo nge-Sentient off. I-Pacing isekela isenzo esisodwa sokuthanda noma sokungasithandi efasiteleni lephosti elingaguquki: i-ejenti ngayinye iphendula kuyo yonke iphosti ehambisanayo, ukujika okukodwa ngesikhathi. Isikhathi sokuqala siqala manje; imikhawulo yesevisi ingandisa isikhathi sokuqeda.
pacing.independent: Imisebenzi ekhuthazwayo isebenza ngokuzimela ngemodi ye-Sentient. Ukucela ukuthandwa akuvuli ukuphosta okuzimele.

tasks.createFirst: Yakha i-ejenti ngezansi ukuze uyinikeze umsebenzi.
tasks.description: Izenzo ziqhutshwa njenge-ejenti ekhethiwe. Imisebenzi eshejuliwe iyaqhubeka nge-app ivaliwe.
tasks.limits: Iphosti eyodwa yansuku zonke nokuthandwa okufika ku-3 okufanelekile ngomsebenzi ngamunye. Wonke ama-ejenti abelana ngegebe lephosti lemizuzu engu-20. Izithombe zisebenzisa izincazelo ezihloliwe; amavidiyo adinga isithombe sendlu. Amaphosti ahlala ngaphansi kwezinhlamvu ezingu-500. Ayikho igesi ngaphandle kwalapho kudwetshwa; ukubhala kungasebenzisa amakhredithi.

workspace.moderationHelp: Qala ngokuvula imvume yokuphatha. I-akhawunti kumele kakade ibe ngumdali wokusakaza noma umphathi owabelwe. Izindlela zokugunyaza nezedrafti zisasebenza. Ukumiswa kwesikhashana kuyaphela ngokuzenzakalelayo.
workspace.webhookHelp: Izicelo zokugunyaza nezenzo ezehlulekile zithumela isaziso esijwayelekile, kungadluli kanye ngehora. Akukho mbhalo wedrafti noma imininingwane yesikhwama ethunyelwayo. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze ukuvale; imiphumela yokulethwa ivela kulogi yokucwaninga.
workspace.reversalHelp: Ukuhoxisa kufihla okuthunyelwe, kususa amazwana unomphela, kubuyisela ukusabela nombhalo wephrofayela, noma kukhansela ukulandela okusha. Ukubuka, izaziso esezilethiwe, imisebenzi yezimali eyenziwe ku-chain, izithombe zephrofayela nokumiswa kwesikhashana okusekuphelile akunakususwa. Okuthunyelwe okufihliwe kusengabuyiswa ngezilawuli zokubonakala kwakho.
workspace.confirmCorrection: Lokhu kushintsha umsebenzi oshicilelwe. Ukususwa kwamazwana akubuyeleki.
workspace.scope: Lezi zilawuli zisebenza emisebenzini ehleliwe, empilweni ezimele nakubasizi abaxhunyiwe. Amadrafti ahlala eyimfihlo uze uwagunyaze.

raffle.title: Imiklomelo
raffle.heroBody: Umklomelo we-DeHub udlulisela amathokheni e-DeHub, i-hardware nezinto zokuqoqa kubantu asebevele besebenzisa inkundla. Ukungena kutholwa ngokubamba iqhaza, uhlu lokungena lushicilelwa ngaphambi kokudonsa, futhi onqobayo ukhethwa ngokuthengiselana noma ubani angafunda.
raffle.noPurchase: Akukho ukuthenga okudingekayo. Ukudweba ngakunye kunendlela yamahhala yokungena, futhi lapho kukhona ithikithi, akulona ukuphela kwendlela yokungena.
raffle.anatomyPrizeBody: Kushiwo lapho ukudweba kuvulwa. Akusoze kwashintshwa kamuva.
raffle.anatomyRoutesBody: Zifakwe kuhlu ngokugcwele, nesisindo esinikezwa yilowo nalowo.
raffle.howBody: Izinyathelo ezine, ngokulandelana okufanayo, njalo. Izingxenye ezinquma ukuthi ubani owinayo zenzeka obala.
raffle.step1Body: Ukudweba ngakunye kuvulwa ngomklomelo wakho, isikhathi sakho sokuvala, nezindlela ezichazayo zokuthola ukungena, okuthunyelwe kuhlelo lokusebenza futhi kunamatheliswe kokudla.
raffle.step2Body: Ukungena kutholwa ngokwenza izinto osuzazi eDeHub. Isimemezelo sibala ukuthi yiziphi izenzo ezibalwa kulokho kudweba nokuthi ukungena ngakunye kubaluleke kangakanani.
raffle.step3Body: Ngesikhathi sokuvala uhlu lokungena luthathwa isithombe-skrini bese kuthathwa inkomba enqobayo emthonjeni wokungahambi kahle ku-chain, hhayi kusuka kuhlu lwezibalo.
raffle.step4Body: Isithombe-skrini, ukuthengiselana, nokungena okunqobayo konke kuya phezulu ndawonye, ​​ngakho-ke noma ubani angabuyekeza umphumela esikhundleni sokukholelwa igama lethu.
raffle.entriesBody: Ukudweba kunikezwe abantu abasebenzisa iDeHub. Isimemezelo ngasinye sibiza izindlela ezibalwa kuso. Lezi yizo izindlela ezidweba ezakhiwa ngazo.
raffle.postBody: Okuthunyelwe, amavidiyo namazwana okuqala kubalwa emidlalweni eyibala.
raffle.stakeBody: Isikhundla sokubeka esivulekile sithola okufakiwe emidlalweni esikukala.
raffle.arcadeBody: Izikhathi ze-Arcade kanye nokubekwa kumabhodi wabaphambili kunikeza imidlalo eyakhelwe emidlalweni.
raffle.stagesBody: Ukuvela eziteji zomsindo ezibukhoma kuyabalwa, noma ngabe ukhuluma noma ulalele.
raffle.ticketBody: Eminye imidwebo iphinde ithengise ithikithi elikhokhwe ngamathokheni e-DeHub. Lapho benza khona, inani nenqwaba yesikhwama ngasinye kushicilelwa kusengaphambili.
raffle.collectibleBody: Imiqoqo ethile ye-NFT iphethe okufakiwe okuhlala njalo emidlalweni eyibala.
raffle.fairnessBody: I-raffle ifanele ukungena kuphela uma umsebenzisi engakwazi ukukhetha ngokuthula owinile. Izinto ezintathu zenza lokho kusebenze lapha.
raffle.fair1Body: Uhlu lokufaka luthwetshulwa ngesikhathi sokuphela esishiwo futhi lushicilelwe ngaphambi kokuthi umdlalo uqale. Akukho lutho olungangezwa kulona kamuva, okuhlanganisa nathi.
raffle.fair2Body: Inkomba yokuwina itholakala ku-chain, ngakho inombolo enquma umdlalo ikhona ekwenzeni okubanzi okungeyona ithuluzi langaphakathi.
raffle.fair3Body: Isithombe, i-transaction hash kanye nokufaka okuwinile kuthunyelwa njengesethi. Ukuphinda ubale izibalo kusuka kudatha yomphakathi kufanele kufinyelele kum winile ofanayo.
raffle.neverPayTitle: I-DeHub ngeke ikucele ukuthi ukhokhe ukuze ukhulule umklomelo
raffle.neverPayBody: Aba winile baqokwa kuhlelo lokusebenza naseposini lomphumela womphakathi. Akekho ku-DeHub ozokuthinta ngemali, isisho sokuqala, ukhiye oyimfihlo noma isignesha yesikhwama ukuze unikele umklomelo. Noma yimiphi imiyalezo enjalo iyinkohliso. Iyibike bese uyisusa.
raffle.faqBody: Lezi esizibuza zona kakhulu mayelana nemidlalo, okufakiwe nemiklomelo.
raffle.faq1Q: Ngidinga ukuthenga yini ukuze ngingene emdlalweni womklomelo we-DeHub?
raffle.faqPurchaseAnswer: Cha. Ukudonsa ngakunye kunendlela yokungena okungenani eyodwa yamahhala, etholwa ngokubamba iqhaza ku-DeHub. Abanye badonsa futhi bathengisa ithikithi elikhokhwe ngamathokheni e-DeHub, kodwa ithikithi alilona ukuphela kwendlela yokungena.
raffle.faq2Q: Ngingazi kanjani ukuthi umdlalo awuzange uqine?
raffle.faq2A: Uhlu lokufaka luthwetshulwa futhi lushicilelwe ngaphambi kokuthi umdlalo uqale, futhi inkomba yokuwina ithathwa emthonjeni wobuhle obuse-chain. Isithombe, i-transaction nokufaka okuwinile kuthunyelwa ndawonye ukuze umphumela uphinde ubale kunoma ubani.
raffle.faq3A: Aba winile baziswa kuhlelo lokusebenza futhi baqokwa eposini lomphumela. Akukho i-imeyili ecela inkokhelo, isisho sokuqala noma isignesha yesikhwama. I-DeHub ngeke icele noma yikuphi kulokhu ukuze ikhulule umklomelo.
raffle.faq4A: Izinsuku ezine kusukela umphumela ushicilelwe. Imiklomelo ye-Token ihlelwa esikhwameni se-DeHub sokuwina ku-Base. Imiklomelo yomzimba ihlelwa ngqo nethimba, futhi ukuthunyelwa kuhlanganiswa lapho singakwazi ukuthumela ngokusemthethweni.
raffle.faq5A: Noma ubani one-akhawunti ye-DeHub oneminyaka engaphezu kwengu-18 futhi ohlala kwenye indawo edonswayo usemthethweni. Izisebenzi ze-DeHub, osonkontileka nemindeni yabo abafaneleki, futhi imidwebo ayinalutho lapho umthetho wendawo ubavimbela khona.
raffle.faq6A: Asikho isheduli engaguquki. Imidwebo ixhunyaniswe nokwethulwa, ingqophamlando nemikhankaso yabalingani, futhi ngayinye imenyezelwa ku-app lapho ivulwa.
raffle.ctaBody: Noma yini ebukhoma manje imenyezelwa ku-feed yakho. Vula izaziso ukuze okulandelayo kungakudlulisi.
raffle.legal: Ukudonswa komklomelo kuyiphromoshini futhi kuvulekele abanikazi be-akhawunti ye-DeHub abaneminyaka engu-18 noma ngaphezulu, akunalutho lapho umthetho wendawo ubavimbela khona. Abasebenzi be-DeHub, osonkontileka nemindeni yabo abafaneleki. Imiklomelo ayinakushintshaniswa ngemali ngaphandle uma kushiwo, futhi isimemezelo somdwebo ngamunye sinemigomo yaso egcwele.

dao.votingPowerNote: Ukuvota kuhlala izinsuku eziyi-7. Amandla okuvota yisamba samathokheni esinikezwe umnikelo ngamunye lapho le ncwadana ivulwa. Okungenani okungu-10% kufanele kuhlanganyele futhi Okwamukelayo kufanele kudlule Okwenqatshelwe.

dao.howItWorksBody: Amandla akho ngumnikelo wakho ohlukaniswe konke okwake kwathunyelwa esikhwameni. Ifundwa ngqo kusuka ku-chain, ayiphelelwa yisikhathi, futhi inquma ukuthi izwi lakho linamandla kangakanani lapho i-DAO ivota ngokuchitha.

screens.freeDmAccessModalDesc: Abasebenzisi abangakuthumelela imiyalezo mahhala, bedlula imali yakho.
screens.glossarySubtitle: Funda ukuthi isithonjana nesici ngasinye kusho ukuthini
screens.glossaryMintTxDesc: Thepha isithonjana solwazi kokuthunyelwe okukhandiwe ukuze uvule ukuthengiselana kokukhanda kwakho ku-block explorer futhi uqinisekise irekhodi elisochungechungeni. Ikhasi eliphelele Lolwazi Lokuthunyelwe — izibalo, abaniniyo, imakethe — likuhlelo lokusebenza lwewebhu ku-dehub.io.
screens.glossaryTokenIdDesc: Isihlonzi esiyingqayizivele esisochungechungeni esinikezwa okuthunyelwe lapho kukhandwa njenge-NFT.
screens.glossaryTipDesc: Thumela ama-tokeni e-DeHub ngqo kumdali wokuqukethwe njengomvuzo ngokuqukethwe kwawo. Amathiphu aqoshwa ku-chain.
screens.glossaryPpvDesc: Okuqukethwe kwe-Premium okudinga ukukhokhelwa ngama-tokeni e-DeHub ukuze kuvulwe. Abadali babeka intengo futhi bahola imali evela ekubukeni ngakunye.
screens.glossaryDhbTokenDesc: I-DHB yisibonakaliso se-ticker sama-tokeni e-DeHub, i-tokeni eyisisekelo ye-DeHub. Isetshenziselwa ukuthumela amathiphu, ukukhokha-ngokubuka-okuqukethwe, ukuvota kwezinhlelo, kanye nokubeka.
screens.glossaryWalletDesc: Isikhwama sakho esiku-chain esiphethe ama-tokeni akho e-DeHub nezinye izimpahla ze-crypto. Ixhumeke nge-Web3Auth ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela.
screens.glossaryStakingDesc: Vala ama-tokeni akho e-DeHub ukuze uzuze imivuzo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ama-tokeni abekiwe nawo akunika amandla okukhulu okuvota ezinhlelweni.
screens.glossaryGovernanceDesc: Hambisa futhi uvote ngeziphakamiso ezibumba inkundla. Amandla akho okuvota anesisindo ngobuningi bama-tokeni e-DeHub owaphethe.
screens.glossaryStakingBadgesDesc: Amabheji abonakala eduze kwegama lakho lomsebenzisi ngokusekelwe kumalungelo akho aphelele we-DeHub tokeni (isikhwama + esibekiwe). Kukhona amazinga angu-13 — lapho uthenga ama-tokeni amaningi, kulapho izinga lakho le-badge liphakeme khona. Amazinga aphezulu anikeza amandla amakhulu okuvota ezinhlelweni kanye nezimali ezincane zenkundla.
screens.glossaryLeaderboardDesc: Abasebenzisi babalwa ngamalungelo aphelele e-DeHub tokeni (isikhwama + abekiwe kuwo wonke ama-chain). Izilinganiso zibuyekezwa ngezikhathi ezithile futhi zilandelwa izinguquko zosuku olungu-1 nosuku olungu-1. Ungakwazi futhi ukuhlunga ngamathiphu athunyelwe, amathiphu atholakele, abalandeli, izintandokazi, noma ababhalisile.

arcade.intro: Imidlalo esebenza lapha ku-app. Akukho okufakwayo, akukho okuthengwayo — umthombo ovulekile, futhi ilethwa yi-DeHub uqobo.

arcade.needsConnection: Umdlalo ukhonzwa ku-dehub.io futhi ulayishwa lapho uwuvula, ngakho udinga ukuxhumana okusebenzayo okokuqala. Hlola okwakho bese uzama futhi.
arcade.privacyWarning: Uma unamathokheni amaningi noma uhlala endaweni engaphephile, fihla ibheji lakho nebhalansi ngaphambi kokusebenzisa lesi sici. Imisebenzi ye-On-chain isabonisa ikheli lakho. Vula izilungiselelo.

switchAccount.intro: Ukungena nge-Google/i-imeyili kungabona isikhwama ESISODWA kuphela se-akhawunti yakho ngesikhathi. Esikhundleni salokho ngena ngokungena OKUDALA kwe-akhawunti oyifunayo — lokhu kwakha kabusha isikhwama sayo lapha efonini yakho, njengokuthi "Shintshela kwenye i-akhawunti endala" kwewebhu.

earningsVs.title: Uma kuqhathaniswa namanye amapulatifomu
earningsVs.subtitle: Imali yakho yangempela ye-DeHub uma iqhathaniswa nalokho okubukwa okufanayo obekuzokukhokha kwenye indawo.
earningsVs.estimatorLabel: Akuzona izinombolo zakho? Zama inani lokubukwa noma yiliphi
earningsVs.noteYoutube: Ngemva kwengxenye engu-45% ye-YouTube yemali yezikhangiso. Iyaguquguquka kakhulu ngokwesihloko nezwe lombukeli.
earningsVs.noteTwitch: Imali yezikhangiso kuphela — ayifaki ama-subs nama-bits, okuvamise ukuba yingxenye enkulu.
earningsVs.noteTiktok: I-Creator Rewards. Yaziwa ngokukhokha kancane ngokubukwa ngakunye; isilinganiso yiso sonke isimo.
earningsVs.noteReels: Izinhlelo zebhonasi zimemo kuphela futhi zivaliwe kaningi.
earningsVs.footnote: Izinombolo zabancintisana nazo ziyizilinganiso ezivela ebangeni lomkhakha elishicilelwe, hhayi izinkokhelo ezilinganisiwe — i-RPM yangempela iyahlukahluka kakhulu ngokuya ngendawo ekhethekile, izwe lababukeli kanye nesikhathi sokubuka, ngakho-ke hlela ireyithi ngayinye ukuze ihambisane nalokho okwenzayo ngempela. Isibalo se-DeHub yimali oyitholayo yangempela yokuthinta eguqulwe ngentengo yamathokheni ebukhoma, futhi ayifaki izincwadi, i-PPV kanye nokuthengiswa kwesitolo. Imibono ihlanganiswa kusuka kokuthunyelwe kwakho okungu-100 kwakamuva.

money.chartMonthly: Imali engenayo nezindleko ngosuku, isilinganiso sanyanga zonke
money.definitionsSubtitle: Yonke imigqa, lapho ifundwa khona, nalokho okushiywe ngaphandle
money.dhbPeg: Alikho inani lemakethe elitholakalayo kulokhu okufundwayo, ngakho-ke i-DHB isepegini.
money.estimatedOperationsNote: Izindleko zokusebenza zilandela umkhuba wanyanga zonke olinganiselwe, ofinyelela phezulu ku-$100,000 ngoNovemba 2021 bese wehla ngemuva kwalokho. Izikweletu ezirekhodiwe zifakiwe, ngaphandle kokubalwa kabili. Lokhu kulinganiselwa, hhayi irejista yama-invoyisi.
money.grossBnbSharingNote: Imali engenayo ihlanganisa i-BNB eyabelwe abanikazi nababambiqhaza. Lezo zinkokhelo zabelwe, azigcinwanga yi-DeHub.
money.reinvestmentNote: I-DeHub ibika ukuthi izimali zokusebenza zomlando ezigciniwe zatshalwa kabusha ngokugcwele. Imali yokukhangisa kanye nemiholo yonjiniyela kukhonjiswa ndawonye, ngokwesilinganiso sanyanga zonke, ngemuva kokukhipha izindleko esezirekhodiwe kuleyo nyanga.
money.title: Imali engenayo nezindleko
money.unavailable: {{sources}} ayikwazanga ukufinyelelwa, ngakho-ke ishiywe ngaphandle kwengqikithi yonke engenhla kunokuba iqagelwe.

taxSplit.footnote: Izimali zokusebenza ezigciniwe kuphela ezibalwa njengemali engenayo ngenhla. Ukuthengwa kabusha kanye nemivuzo eyabelwe kurekhodwa ngokuhlukile. Yonke imali kanye nemali yokuqala kungahlolwa kurejista.
taxSplit.intro: Imali engenayo yomlando ixhase imisebenzi, ukuthengwa kabusha kwamathokheni kanye nemivuzo yabanikazi nababambiqhaza. Izimali zikhonjiswa ngamadola ngenani elalikhona ngosuku ngalunye lokukhokha. Vula ingxenye ngayinye ukuze ubone izimali zayo zokuqala kanye nakho konke okwenziwe.
taxSplit.title: Lapho imali engenayo iye khona

feedback.title: Umuntu Onethembeka
feedback.intro: Nabe kusetshenziswa iDeHub isikhathi eside? Sitshele ukuthi kwakunjani. Okuhle, okubi noma okuthile okucacile — konke kufundwa. Uma usiyavumelela ukuthi sikuquote, bheka ibhokisi futhi singase sikusetshenzise ezipositini, emavidiyo noma kusite.
feedback.consentPromo: Ngivumela iDeHub ukuthi iquote le feedback ku-marketing kanye ne-promotional materials.
feedback.consentName: Ungakwazi ukubonisa i-username yami nayo. Shiya lokhu ungabhekile ukuze kuquotwe ngo-anonymous.
feedback.thanks: Siyakuqonda — ngiyabonga. Noma yini oyivumelele ye-promotional use iyahlolwa umuntu ngaphambi kokuba ivele kunoma kuphi.

stats.subtitle: Izibalo zomphakathi ezibukhoma
stats.source: Umlando we-akhawunti orekhodiwe ophuma kwi-endpoint yezibalo zomphakathi ye-DeHub. Awekho amanani alinganiselwe asetshenziswa kuleli shadi.

solana.unavailableBody: Le divayisi ayiluphethe ukhiye wesikhwama sakho se-DeHub. Ngena futhi ukuze ubuyisele, nesikhwama sakho se-Solana sibuya naso.
solana.fundingBody: Ukuthumela, ukunikela nokuvula ku-Solana konke kukhokhelwa kusuka kuleli kheli. Thumela i-SOL kulo usuka ku-exchange noma kwesinye isikhwama — cishe i-0.01 SOL yanele okuthunyelwe okuningana. Litholakala esikhwameni sakho se-DeHub, ngakho libuya kunoma iyiphi idivayisi ongena kuyo.
solana.mintingOff: Ukuthumela ku-Solana kuvaliwe kuseva njengamanje. Isikhwama sakho nebhalansi akuthintekile.
solana.legacyBody: Inguqulo yangaphambili yohlelo yakha isikhwama se-Solana esehlukene esasikhona kule divayisi kuphela. Sisenemali. Dlulisela imali kwikheli elingenhla ngenkathi usenale foni — lowo khiye awukwazi ukutholakala kwenye indawo.

walletSetup.tryBiometricsHint: Sebenzisa lokhu uma usethe lesi sikhwama kule foni futhi ukhiye kufanele ukuthi usevele ulapha
walletSetup.restoreMissing: Isikhwama sale phrofayela asikho kule foni, ngakho akukho okungasayinwa okwamanje. Faka umushwana wokubuyisela noma ukhiye wangasese ukuze usilethe lapha.
walletSetup.noPhraseNoKey: Awunayo inkulumo futhi awunalo ukhiye? Lesi sikhwama singavulwa kuphela kudivayisi eyasakha — akukho lutho kuwebhusayithi noma ohlangothini lwethu olungasibuyisa. Ngena kuleyo divayisi uma usenayo.
walletSetup.resetExplainer: Lokhu kunika ukungena kwakho isikhwama esisha ngokuphelele, esingenalutho, futhi kudlulisele i-akhawunti yakho kuso. Akusivuli isikhwama esidala — le foni ayikwazi, i-dehub.io ayikwazi, nathi asikwazi — ngakho noma yini engaphakathi ihlala lapho.
walletSetup.checkingWaysBack: Sihlola ukuthi unayo enye indlela yokubuyela kulesi sikhwama…
walletSetup.couldNotCopy: Ayikwazanga ukukopisha — esikhundleni salokho bhala amagama phansi.
walletSetup.couldNotFinishSetup: Ayikwazanga ukuqeda ukusetha le akhawunti. Sicela uzame futhi.
walletSetup.securingWallet: Sivikela isikhwama sakho — kwamanye amadivayisi lokhu kungathatha kuze kufike kumzuzu owodwa…
walletSetup.unlockingWallet: Sivula isikhwama sakho — kwamanye amadivayisi lokhu kungathatha kuze kufike kumzuzu owodwa…
walletSetup.understandOldWalletA11y: Ngiyaqonda ukuthi isikhwama esidala, nanoma yini ekuso, ngeke kusatholakala
walletSetup.protectWallet: Ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi nguwe kuphela ongathumela noma athenge ngale akhawunti, vikela isikhwama sakho nge-biometrics yedivayisi yakho noma ngephasiwedi.
walletSetup.ifYouUsedDehub: Uma usuke wasebenzisa i-dehub.io ngaphambili, yivule kukhompyutha yakho, ungene ngendlela efanayo nangakhawunti efanayo, bese
walletSetup.biometricExplainer: Vula ngezigxivizo zeminwe noma ubuso bakho — akukho lutho okufanele ulubhale noma ulukhumbule. Ukhiye uhlala kule foni, ngakho sizokukhombisa inkulumo yokubuyisa yamagama angu-12 ozoyibhala phansi; yiyona kuphela indlela yokubuyela ngefoni ehlukile, ngewebhusayithi, noma ngemva kokufaka kabusha. Khetha Iphasiwedi esikhundleni salokho, bese iphasiwedi uqobo yenza lowo msebenzi.
walletSetup.biometricExplainerSecuring: Vula ngezigxivizo zeminwe noma ubuso bakho — akukho lutho okufanele ulubhale noma ulukhumbule. Ukhiye uhlala kule foni. Ukuze ubuyele ngefoni ehlukile, ngewebhusayithi, noma ngemva kokufaka kabusha, gcina isipele samagama angu-12 kamuva ku-Zilungiselelo. Khetha Iphasiwedi esikhundleni salokho, bese iphasiwedi uqobo yenza lowo msebenzi.
walletSetup.biometricPrompt: Lesi sikhwama sivikelwa yi-biometrics yale divayisi. Qinisekisa ngesigxivizo somunwe noma ubuso ukuze uqhubeke.
walletSetup.enterRecoveryPhrase: Faka inkulumo yokubuyisa yamagama angu-12 owayigcina lapho udala lesi sikhwama (noma ukhiye waso oyimfihlo, uma wake wawukhipha). Ibuyela ku-akhawunti efanayo, futhi iphasiwedi oyisetha ngezansi iba yisipele esisebenza yonke indawo kusukela manje.
walletSetup.resetAndCreate: Setha kabusha bese wakha isikhwama esisha
walletSetup.thatsGoneToo: Nalokho kulahlekile — qala kabusha noma kunjalo
walletSetup.confirmStartOver: Qinisekisa ukuthi ufuna ukuqala kabusha ngesikhwama esisha
walletSetup.understandOldWallet: Ngiyaqonda ukuthi isikhwama esidala, nakho konke okukuso, ngeke ngisakwazi ukukuthola naphakade
walletSetup.legacyRecovered: Siqinisekise i-akhawunti yakho endala{{suffix}} futhi sabuyisa isikhwama sayo. Setha iphasiwedi ukuyivikela kule divayisi — kule foni nakuzo zonke ezinye izindawo, kusukela manje.
walletSetup.recoveryRecordNotice: Le akhawunti inerekhodi lokubuyisa recovery record kusuka ku-dehub.io. Ikhodi yokubuyisa yamagama angama-24 oyinikeziwe isavula leli walethi. Vula i-dehub.io kukhompyutha, ungene ngendlela efanayo nangaleyo akhawunti, bese usebenzisa leyo khodi — iletha iwalethi, ne-akhawunti yakho, njengoba zazinjalo.
walletSetup.passkeyNoticeSingle: Le akhawunti inokuvulwa kwe-passkey okubhalisiwe ku-dehub.io. Esipheqululini esiyiphethe, i-dehub.io ingavula leli walethi.
walletSetup.passkeyNoticeMultiple: Le akhawunti inokuvulwa kwe-passkey okungaphezu kokukodwa okubhalisiwe ku-dehub.io. Esipheqululini esiphethe noma yikuphi kuzo, i-dehub.io ingavula leli walethi.
walletSetup.otherWaysCheckFailed: Ayikwazanga ukuhlola ukuthi unezinye izindlela zokubuyela kuleli walethi. Uma wake walungisa ikhodi yokubuyisa noma i-passkey ku-dehub.io, hamba uzame lokho kuqala — ukuqhubeka lapha kuzosula zona.
walletSetup.loseFundsBody: Izilinganiso zayo zihlala ku-{{address}}blockchain — akukho okuchithwayo noma okuthathwayo — kodwa ukuzihambisa kudinga umusho wokubuyisa waleyo walethi noma ukhiye oyimfihlo. Ngaphandle kwawo, akekho ongakwazi ukufinyelela kuwo: hhayi wena, hhayi thina. Ngaphandle kokuthi ukwazi ukukhipha ukhiye kudivayisi eyiwumbayo, phatha lokho okukuyo njengokulahlekile.
walletSetup.loseRecoveryBody: Irekodi lokubuyisa ku-dehub.io lisulwa njengengxenye yalokhu, ngakho-ke leyo ndlela nayo iyavalwa.
walletSetup.loseRecoveryUnknownBody: Uma wake walungisa ikhodi yokubuyisa yamagama angama-24 ku-dehub.io, iyasulwa njengengxenye yalokhu. Asikwazanga ukuhlola ukuthi unayo yini.
walletSetup.losePasskeysBody: Ama-passkey abhaliswe ku-dehub.io asuswa njengengxenye yalokhu.
walletSetup.losePasskeysUnknownBody: Noma yimaphi ama-passkey abhaliswe ku-dehub.io asuswa njengengxenye yalokhu. Asikwazanga ukuhlola ukuthi unayo yini.
walletSetup.keepAccountBody: Igama lomsebenzisi, iphrofayela, okuthunyelwe, ukuphawula, abalandeli, izindondo kanye nomlando konke kuyahamba kuye kule walethi entsha. Kuyi-akhawunti efanayo — akekho okudingeka akutholakale futhi.
walletSetup.keepMessagesBody: Izingxoxo, izaziso, izincwadi, okuthunyelwe okugciniwe nomlando wokubuka kuza nawe. Akukho lutho olusulwayo futhi akekho omunye ongakufunda.
walletSetup.keepSignInBody: Inombolo yocingo efanayo, i-imeyili noma i-akhawunti ye-Google, ukuthepha okukodwa okufanayo. Yileyo walethi engemuva kokungena esikhundleni, hhayi ukungena.
walletSetup.checkDeviceBody: Ifoni igcina ikhophi yayo yokhiye ngenkathi i-DeHub ifakiwe, futhi isiphequluli sigcina i-passkey yaso. Uma usenayo noma yikuphi, hamba lapho, thumela ukhiye oyimfihlo, bese ubuyela lapha bese usebenzisa i-Restore esikhundleni — lokho kugcina nezilinganiso.
walletSetup.passwordBreached: Le phasiwedi ivele ku-data breach — khetha enye ehlukile
walletSetup.phraseInvalidHint: Lokho akuhambisani njengephasiwedi yokubuyisa — amagama ayi-12, ngokulandelana kwawo, wonke angama-lowercase.
walletSetup.privateKeyHint: Ukhiye oyimfihlo ungama-64 wezinhlamvu ze-hex ngemuva kwe-0x.
walletSetup.noUsableBackup: Le akhawunti inekheli lewalethi elingefayeleni, kodwa ayikho isipele leli foni elingasisebenzisa — noma yavalwa nge-biometrics noma i-passkey kuwebhu (lokho kuvulwa kuhlala esipheqululini futhi akuhambisani lapha), noma ukubhalisa kwangaphambili kuleli foni kwaphazamiseka ngaphambi kokuba kuqedwe.
walletSetup.addPasswordOnWeb: Uma wake wazisebenzisa i-dehub.io ngaphambili, yivule kukhompyutha yakho, ungene ngendlela efanayo nangaleyo akhawunti, bese u-engeza iphasiwedi ye-wallet — lokho kugcina isipele esibethelwe efwini. Bese ubuyela lapha bese uzama futhi.
walletSetup.biometricKeepsFailing: {{error}} Uma lokhu kuqhubeka nokuhluleka, sebenzisa iphasiwedi yakho ye-wallet ngezansi noma u-"Ngenisa i-wallet yangaphandle".
walletSetup.deviceBoundKey: Le wallet ivulwa nge-biometrics egcinwe kudivayisi eyodwa ethize — ifoni noma isiphequluli lapho yasetshenziswa khona. Le foni ayinawo lowo okhiye, futhi ne-dehub.io ayinawo: okhiye abaphumi kudivayisi eyawenzayo.
walletSetup.unlockPasskeyOnly: Le wallet yavikelwa nge-passkey kuwebhu futhi ayikabi nayo isipele sephasiwedi efwini. Uma usetha iphasiwedi ye-wallet ku-dehub.io, uyifake lapha — kungenjalo sebenzisa i-Ngenisa i-wallet yangaphandle ngezansi.
walletSetup.unlockWithPasswordExplainer: Le akhawunti isivele inayo i-wallet, evikelwe ngephasiwedi. Yifake ukuze ubuyise i-wallet yakho kule divayisi.
walletSetup.deviceExplainer: Akukho ongakuthayipha noma ukukukhumbula — ukuhlala kokhiye kule divayisi. Sizokunikeza isipele esinamagama angu-12 ukuze usibhale phansi; ukuphela kwendlela yokungena kusuka kwenye idivayisi, kusuka kuwebhusayithi, noma ngemva kokufaka kabusha. Khetha Iphasiwedi kunalokho bese iphasiwedi ngokwayo yenza lowo msebenzi.
walletSetup.deviceExplainerSecuring: Akukho lutho okufanele ulubhale noma ulukhumbule — ukhiye uhlala kule divayisi. Ukuze ubuyele ngenye idivayisi, ngewebhusayithi, noma ngemva kokufaka kabusha, gcina isipele samagama angu-12 kamuva ku-Zilungiselelo. Khetha Iphasiwedi esikhundleni salokho, bese iphasiwedi uqobo yenza lowo msebenzi.

commonGround.title: Umhlaba Ovamile
commonGround.sheetHint: Ikhefu elifushane ngaphambi kokuphendula kwakho. Izimpendulo zakho zihlala ziyimfihlo.
commonGround.toggleHint: Ngaphambi kokuphendula kwabo kokuqala, abafundi bayacelwa iphuzu elinamandla kakhulu kolunye uhlangothi nokuthi bobabili babelana ngani, bese bekhunjuzwa ukuthi bagweme ukucabanga okuthi "noma lokhu noma lokho".
commonGround.banner: Lo mdali uvule imodi Yomhlaba Ovamile. Ngaphambi kokuba uphendule uzocelwa iphuzu elinamandla kakhulu kolunye uhlangothi nokuthi yini eniyihlanganyelayo.
commonGround.step1Title: Ngokomushwana owodwa, yini iphuzu elinamandla kakhulu kolunye uhlangothi?
commonGround.step2Title: Yini enivumelana ngayo wena nabo empeleni?
commonGround.reminderTitle: Qaphela ukucabanga okuthi konke noma akukho lutho
commonGround.reminderBody: Okungavumelani okuningi akukona ukukhetha phakathi kwezinto ezimbili eziphambene. Lapho umbuzo uzwakala sengathi "noma lokhu noma lokho", kuvame ukuba khona inketho yesithathu phakathi.
commonGround.example1: Umakhelwane ofuna umgwaqo othule nokuthi umakhelwane ofuna indawo yokupaka eyengeziwe bangaba nelungelo ngalokho abakudingayo.
commonGround.example2: Abazali ababili bangase bangavumelani ngesikhathi sokusebenzisa izikrini futhi basavumelana ngokuthi ingane kufanele ilele kahle futhi iphumelele esikoleni.
commonGround.noShouting: Izindaba eziyinkimbinkimbi azisoze zahlanganiswa ngokumemeza noma izinsongo. Impendulo ethule, enemininingwane iyona abantu abayifundayo ngempela.
commonGround.privateNote: Izimpendulo zakho zingezakho zodwa futhi azifakwa nempendulo yakho.
commonGround.tooShort: Bhala okungenani izinhlamvu eziyi-10 ukuze ukucabanga kubalwe ngempela.
commonGround.saveFailed: Ayikwazanga ukulondoloza isilungiselelo soMhlaba Ovamile. Sicela uzame futhi.

pages.label: Amakhasi
pages.allNotes: Wonke amakhasi e- {{count}} kufayela elilodwa lamanothi
pages.batchNameHint: Sebenzisa umugqa wokuqala wesihloko esikhulu esibonakalayo sekhasi ngalinye. Amagama wamakhasi akhona ahlala ngaphandle uma ukhetha ukuwafaka esikhundleni sawo.
pages.durationBatchHint: Ukunweba imisebenzi yobuciko esafinyelela ekugcineni kwekhasi. Ukunciphisa iziqeshana zama-trim; ukushintshwa kwamakhasi kamuva. Imidiya igcina ijubane layo lokudlala.
pages.namedFromHeadings: Iqanjwe ngokuthi {{count}} amakhasi. {{missing}} amakhasi abengenaso isihloko.
pages.rangeHint: Sebenzisa izinombolo zekhasi ezihlukaniswe ngamakoma, noma amabanga afana no-3-8.
pages.transferHint: Kopisha kumakhasi angafika kwangu-50, noma uthuthele kwelilodwa. Amaqembu nokubekwa kulandela lokho okukhethiwe. Ukuthutha kuthinta leli khasi kuphela; okunye ukubonakala kuyagcinwa. Indawo oya kuyo kumele ilingane nezendlalelo ezinesikhathi.
pages.transferLayers: Thutha noma kopisha izendlalelo ezikhethiwe kumakhasi
pages.visibilityHint: Amakhasi afihliwe ahlala ehleleka futhi ayatholakala ukuze alandwe.

export.rangeHint: Igcina amazwibela nomsindo ekusikeni ngakunye. Ifayela ngalinye lifaka isiphetho semizuzwana engu-2.2 se-DeHub. Ukudawuniloda amafayela amaningi ndawonye NJENGE-ZIP.
export.archiveTooLarge: Ukudawuniloda kudlula u-512 MiB. Thumela iziqeshana ezimbalwa noma ukhethe isixazululo esiphansi.
export.gifHint: I-looping animation ngaphandle komsindo. Kuze kube yimizuzwana engu-60, amaphikseli angu-640 nama-fps angu-15. Kuhlanganisa ukuphela kwe-logo yakho.
export.gifTooLong: Nciphisa umugqa wesikhathi ube yimizuzwana engu-60 noma ngaphansi, noma ukhethe i-MP4 noma i-WebM.
export.cropMarkHint: Ingeza izimpawu zokusika ngaphandle komsebenzi wobuciko. Isinqumo sokuphrinta esilondoloziwe sibeka usayizi wekhasi oqediwe.
export.documentImageHint: Imininingwane ephezulu igcina izithombe zamakhasi ezinkulu. Amafayela amancane anciphisa ubukhulu besithombe nekhwalithi ye-JPEG. Usayizi wekhasi nezixhumanisi kuyagcinwa.
export.filenameHint: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze uthole amagama azenzakalelayo. Sebenzisa {title}, {name}, {section}, {page}, noma {page:3}. Engeza isiqalo njengombhalo ocacile. Amagama aphindwe kabili athola isijobelelo senombolo yekhasi.
export.jpegQualityHint: Ikhwalithi ephansi ngokuvamile ikhiqiza amafayela amancane. Ubukhulu be-pixel buhlala bufana; umsebenzi wobuciko onemininingwane ungase ubonise ukucindezelwa.
export.notesTextHint: Ilanda izihloko zesigaba, izinombolo zamakhasi zangempela, amagama amakhasi, namanothi omethuli njengefayela lombhalo.
export.pageOrderHint: Amakhasi alandela ukulandelana okufakiwe. Sebenzisa u-3,1-2 ukuze uqale ngekhasi 3, noma u-5-1 ukuze uhlehlise ububanzi. Izinombolo zamakhasi eziphindwayo zivela kanye.
export.pptxHint: Ikhasi ngalinye liba isithombe sesilayidi esisodwa, esinamanothi omethuli nezixhumanisi. Hlela umbhalo ngamunye nezakhi kumklamo wokuqala.

motion.title: Ukunyakaza
motion.hint: Amafreyimu ayisihluthulelo enza isendlalelo sinyakaze ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Engeza elilodwa lapha, hambisa ikhanda lokudlala, shintsha isendlalelo, sizoshelela phakathi kwawo.
motion.outside: Hambisa ikhanda lokudlala phezu kwalesi sendlalelo ukuze wengeze noma ushintshe amafreyimu ayisihluthulelo.
motion.curveHint: Hudula izibambo ukuze ubumbe ukuthi isendlalelo sihamba kanjani kusuka kule freyimu kuya kweelandelayo.
motion.noCurve: Beka ikhanda lokudlala efreyimini eyisihluthulelo ukuze ubumbe ijika layo.
motion.applyAll: Sebenzisa leli jika kuwo wonke amafreyimu ayisihluthulelo
motion.timelineKey: Ifreyimu eyisihluthulelo. Hudula ukuze uyihambise, thepha kabili ukuze uyisuse.
motion.recordHint: Iyarekhoda: ukuhambisa, ukushintsha usayizi, ukuzungezisa noma ukufiphalisa isendlalelo ngaphansi kwekhanda lokudlala kwengeza amafreyimu ayisihluthulelo lapho.
motion.scrub: Hudula kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla ukuze ushintshe.

live.privateHint: Ukuba khona kukodwa akwabelwa lutho. Ukwabelana ngokuhlela bukhoma kufaka imithombo emisha ngasese. Londoloza efwini ligcina uhlelo oluhlala njalo.
live.hint: Yabelana ngobukhona bakho nabahleli bale phrojekthi.
live.disconnected: Akuxhunyiwe. Joyina futhi ukuze uxhume kabusha.
live.saveHint: Use Save to cloud to share timeline changes.
live.error: Iseshini ebukhoma ayitholakali. Ngena ngemvume futhi ugcine le phrojekthi efwini, noma uhlole isimemo sakho sokuhlela.

charts.areaModeHint: Izindawo ezinqwabelene nezilinganayo zibonisa uchungechunge ngalunye njengebhendi. Ama-Streamgraph aphakathi kwengqikithi engaba ngu-zero bese ufihla inhloso yereferensi. Lezi zakhiwo zidinga amanani omthombo angewona amabi. Isibonisi esilinganiselwe sigcina izibalo zokuqala kudatha; izindawo ezihambisanayo zingahlanganisa amanani amabi.
charts.benchmarkHint: Gcwalisa ithagethi emisiwe kuwo wonke amanani omthombo wamanje. Sebenzisa umugqa wethagethi ukuwusebenzisa; bala kabusha ngemva kokuhlela idatha.
charts.brandPaletteHint: Ilulayisha iphalethi elondoloziwe kulo mdwebo weshadi. Iphalethi elondoloziwe igcina imibala yeshadi ehlukene eyishumi yokuqala ezitayeleni ze-Brand. Amanani eshadi ahlala engashintshile.
charts.bubbleColumnHint: Izixhumanisi ze-X zihlala kukholamu yokuqala. Ikholamu ye-Y ekhethiwe kuphela ethinta isikali esime mpo. Ikholamu yosayizi idinga amanani angeyona awe-negative anenani elilodwa okungenani eliyi-positive; osayizi abalinganayo basebenzisa izisindo zeyunithi. Ukuhlela kabusha amakholamu kugcina lezi zindima nedatha yazo.
charts.bubbleHint: Sebenzisa izixhumanisi ze-X zezinombolo kukholamu yokuqala. Kumodi yochungechunge oluningi, khetha amakholamu e-Y nawosayizi ngezansi; okuzenzakalelayo kusebenzisa uchungechunge lokuqala lwe-Y kanti olwesibili lusebenzisa usayizi. Izindawo zilingana nosayizi; osayizi abanguziro bayafihlwa. Ngaphandle kochungechunge losayizi, amabhamuza ayalingana. Uchungechunge olwengeziwe luhlala kudatha yomthombo. Amalebula amanani akhombisa u-Y / usayizi. Ama-eksisi nesikali kungasebenzisa izinsuku nezikhathi ze-UTC ze-X.
charts.bubbleSingleColumn: Nika amandla uchungechunge lwedatha oluningi ukuze ukhethe amakholamu e-Y nawosayizi ahlukene. Idatha yochungechunge olulodwa isebenzisa osayizi bamabhamuza alinganayo.
charts.categoryAxisHint: Gcina yonke iphoyinti ledatha ngenkathi ubeka amalebula alo. Izigaba zokuqala nezokugcina zihlala zinelebula. Amalebula atshekile asebenzisa umugqa owodwa; buyela ku-0° ukuze usebenzise ukusonga.
charts.categorySummaryHint: Lonke uchungechunge lufingqwa ngokwehlukana. Izigaba zigcina igama lazo lokuqala, indawo kanye nombala wesigaba. Ukubalwa kwemigqa kubala imigqa yomthombo efanayo kuwo wonke uchungechunge. Sebenzisa okuthi Hlehlisa ushintsho lomdwebo ukuze ubuyisele imigqa yasekuqaleni.
charts.dateAxisHint: Sebenzisa izinsuku ze-ISO (2026-01-31) noma izitempu zesikhathi ze-UTC (2026-01-31T14:30Z) kukholamu yokuqala yedatha. Izikhundla zibonisa isikhathi esidlulile, okuhlanganisa nezikhala. Amalebula ezinsuku nezikhathi asebenzisa i-UTC kuwo wonke amadivayisi. Imingcele yandisa isikali ngenkathi igcina yonke idatha ibonakala.
charts.donutTotalHint: Isamba sihlanganisa izingxenye ezinhle futhi sisebenzisa ifomethi yenani ekhethiwe.
charts.filterHint: Izimo ezintathu ezisebenzayo kumele zihambisane zonke. Ukuhlunga kushintsha ishadi elibonisiwe kanye nokuthunyelwa kwezithombe kuyilapho kugcinwa wonke umugqa womthombo. Izihlungi zochungechunge ezinamagama ziyashaywa indiva uma lolo chungechunge lususwa noma luqanjwa kabusha. Izithombe zenqubekelaphambili zigcina inani lazo lokuqala lomthombo.
charts.funnelHint: Izigaba zilandela ukulandelana kwemigqa. Sebenzisa amanani angeyona imbi anesigaba esisodwa esihle okungenani. Imibala yezigaba, amalebula kanye namanani ahlelwa ngokwehlukana.
charts.hierarchyImportHint: Namathisela idatha ye-CSV noma ehlukaniswe ngethebhu enezikholomu zesigaba eziyisithupha kanye nekholomu yosayizi wenombolo yokugcina. Imigqa efika kwengu-50 iba yizindlela zokuhleleka ezihlukaniswe ngemivimbo. Amaseli esigaba kumele agcwaliswe futhi awakwazi ukuba no-/. Lokhu kuthatha indawo yedatha esalungiswa ngolunye uchungechunge.
charts.histogramFormatHint: Ifomethi yokubonisa inombolo imisa imingcele yezikhala; amafrikhwensi ahlala njengokubalwa. Amasethi edatha amancane noma afanayo asebenzisa izikhala ezimbalwa. Umngcele ongaphezulu ungowesikhala sokugcina.
charts.intervalsHint: Izikhawu eziningi zinikeza amalebula esikali acace kakhudlwana; ezimbalwa zenza isakhiwo esihlanzekile. Amashadi okusabalalisa kanye namashadi amabhamuza angalungisa izikali ezivundlile neziqondile ngokuzimela.
charts.markerHint: Izimo namaphethini emigqa kunikeza enye indlela yokuhlukanisa uchungechunge. Okhiye bezincazelo balandela isakhiwo. Usayizi wephoyinti ongu-zero ufihla omaka; osayizi bamabhamuza bagcina isikali sawo sendawo eyindilinga.
charts.missingFilterSeries: Izihlungi {{filters}} zibhekisela ochungechungeni olungekho noma olungacacile futhi okwamanje azinakiwe.
charts.noBrandPalettes: Londoloza iphalethi yemibala kuzitayela ze-Brand ukuze uyisebenzise lapha.
charts.noTypes: Azikho izinhlobo zamashadi ezihambisanayo. Zama okunye ukusesha noma iqembu.
charts.observationHint: Namathisela izinombolo ezifika ku-50 ezihlukaniswe ngo-comma, amathebhu noma ukweqiwa komugqa. Lokhu kuthatha indawo yedatha esalungiswa ngolunye uchungechunge. Okubhekwayo kwasekuqaleni kuhlala kumaseli naku-CSV yomthombo; amabhini e-histogram abalelwa ukuboniswa.
charts.orderHint: Amanani kulo lonke uchungechunge ahamba nezigaba zawo. Imibala yezigaba zochungechunge olulodwa ilandela ukuhleleka okufanayo.
charts.percentHint: Faka amaphuzu amaphesenti: inani elingu-25 liboniswa njengo-25%.
charts.percentStackHint: Isigaba ngasinye sibonisa izabelo zamaphesenti. Amanani amahle namabi ngalinye lihlanganisa u-100% ohlangothini lwawo lwe-zero. Amanani omthombo ahlala kugridi yedatha nasekulandweni kwe-CSV.
charts.pictogramRounding: Izimpawu zilinganisa isabelo ngasinye kusetshenziswa izithonjana eziphelele. Izabelo ezincane zingazungeziswa zibe u-zero; incazelo igcina amanani omthombo. Khulisa izimpawu eziphelele ukuze uthole imininingwane emihle. Ukubalwa kwezithonjana akuthathi indawo yedatha yakho.
charts.pieValueHint: Nika amandla u-Show values ukuze ubonise le fomethi. Izabelo zisebenzisa izingcezu ezinhle kuphela; inani eliphakathi nendawo ligcina ifomethi yalo yenani.
charts.progressColours: Umbala wokuqala wephalethi ugcwalisa inqubekelaphambili; owesibili ubonisa ithrekhi esele. I-Show values ilawula ilebula lepesenti. Lawa mashadi asebenzisa inani lomthombo wokuqala kuphela.
charts.raceHint: Sebenzisa idatha yochungechunge oluningi ngezigaba kukholomu yokuqala. Amakholomu amabili kuya kwayisithupha alandelayo amafreyimu alandelanayo; amagama awo avela njengezincazelo zefreyimu. Izindinganiso kumelwe zingabi ezingezinhle. Izigaba zigcina imibala yazo njengoba izilinganiso zishintsha. Ukudlala kudlulisela isikhathi sesikhathi sesithombe.
charts.racePosterHint: Ifreyimu esaqhubeka ilawula i-SVG nokubuka kuqala okusalungiswa. Vala i-animation ukuze ufake lelo freyimu emgqeni wesikhathi futhi. Ukuthunyelwa kwe-animated raster nevidiyo kusebenzisa isikhathi sokudlala. Wonke amafreyimu abelana ngesikali esiphezulu esinqunyiwe.
charts.referenceHint: Umgomo wandisa isikali senani uma kudingeka. Imigomo enamaphesenti asebenzisa amaphesenti amaphuzu; eminye imigomo isebenzisa amayunithi omthombo.

scale.hint: Imingcele yandisa isikali esizenzakalelayo ukuze amashadi ahlobene akwazi ukuhlanganyela uhla. Izindinganiso ezingaphandle kwaleyo mikhawulo zihlala zibonakala.

charts.scatterHint: Izindawo zokuhlakaza zisebenzisa izixhumanisi zezinombolo ze-X kukholomu yokuqala namanani ka-Y kumakholomu asele. Uchungechunge oluningi lwabelana ngalezo zixhumanisi ze-X. Khetha Izinsuku nezikhathi ze-UTC kuma-Axes bese ulinganisa i-axis evundlile yesikhathi esidlule.
charts.scatterLinesHint: Imigqa ilandela ukulandelana komugqa. Hlunga ngo-X wezinombolo kuDatha ukuze uxhume amaphuzu ukusuka kwesobunxele kuya kwesokudla. Uchungechunge olulodwa lusebenzisa umbala walo wokuqala wephalethi kulayini.
charts.seriesStructureHint: Amanani nemibala kulandela uchungechunge ngalunye. Uchungechunge olusha luqala ku-zero. Qamba kabusha uchungechunge emgqeni wokuqala wegridi yedatha.
charts.starterHint: Isiqalo sithatha indawo yohlobo lwedatha, idatha, nokufometha kwalolu hlaka. Ikhanvasi yakho yamanje ishintsha kuphela uma ubuyekeza noma ufaka isithombe.
charts.styleFileHint: Idlulisa ukubukeka namaphalethi phakathi kwamadivayisi. Idatha yeshadi, uhlobo, izihloko, umbhalo ophakathi nendawo kanye nemingcele yesikali kuhlala kuklamo okuyiwa kulo.
charts.styleKeepsData: Izitayela zigcina uhlobo lwakho lweshadi, idatha, ifomethi yezinombolo, imingcele yesikali, nombhalo ophakathi nendawo.
charts.transposeHint: Izigaba eziyisithupha zingaba uchungechunge. Uchungechunge olukhona luba yizigaba; ukulandelana kwephalethi kuhlala kungashintshile.
charts.transposeScatter: Shintsha uye eshadini lesigaba ukuze uguqule idatha.
charts.treemapHint: Sebenzisa izindlela eziyingqayizivele zamaqabunga ezifana ne-Europe / France ne-Europe / Germany. Kusekelwa amazinga afika kwayisithupha. Amanani kumele abe ngaphezu kuka-zero, okungenani elilodwa libe nenani elihle. Amanani anguziro ayafihlwa. Indlela ayikwazi ukuba yiqembu kanye neqabunga ngesikhathi esisodwa. Uchungechunge lokuqala luhlinzeka ngamanani; olunye uchungechunge lomthombo luyagcinwa.
charts.typeDraftHint: Ukushintsha uhlobo kugcina idatha yakho yohlaka. Buyekeza noma ufake isithombe uma usukulungele.

backgrounds.applyAll: Kopisha ingemuva lekhasi kuwo wonke amakhasi
backgrounds.hint: Kopisha isithombe, i-gradient, noma ingemuva eliqinile laleli khasi. Izizinda ezikhiyiwe zihlala zingashintshile.

brush.convertHint: Ifaka esikhundleni somzila ongaphakathi kwebhokisi lawo lamanje isimo esihlelekayo. Isikhundla, usayizi, ukujikeleza, umugqa, imiphumela, ukuhlanganiswa kanye nesikhathi kuyagcinwa. Imidwebo evulekile iba yimigqa. Ukuhlehlisa kubuyisela umzila odwetshiwe.
brush.pointHint: Ukwenza lula kususela ekuchezukeni okuncane maqondana nebhokisi lomdwebo. Imidwebo evaliwe igcina okungenani amaphuzu amathathu. Ukubushelela nezitayela zomugqa kusebenza; ukuhlehlisa kubuyisela amaphuzu okuqala.

bulk.connectionFileHint: Idlulisa umbhalo, i-QR, isithombe, isixhumanisi kanye nokuxhumana kwenkambu yekhasi ngongqimba nangamagama amakholomu. Ukuxhumana okufanayo kufaka esikhundleni sokuhlelwa kwakho kwamanje; okunye ukuhlelwa kuyahlala. Qamba izingqimba ezixhunyiwe ngokuhlukile ngaphambi kokuthumela ngaphandle. Amarekhodi espredishithi nemidwebo yomklamo akufakiwe.
bulk.connectionPlan: {{matched}} okufanayo; {{layers}} izingqimba ezingekho, {{columns}} amakholomu angekho, {{ambiguous}} ukufana okungacacile kweqiwe
bulk.created: Kudalwe amakhasi {{count}}. Ukuhlehlisa kubuyisela umklamo wokuqala.
bulk.filterHint: Ukufana akubheki ukuthi uhlamvu lukhulu noma luncane futhi akubheki izikhala eziseceleni. Izinombolo zemigqa yohlu lwezibalo zangempela ziyagcinwa.
bulk.hint: Sebenzisa ikhasi lamanje njengesifanekiso. Xhuma imibhalo nezendlalelo ze-QR kumakholomu ohlu lwezibalo, noma faka amagama amakholomu kubakaki ababili ngaphakathi kombhalo wakho. Umugqa ngamunye okhethiwe udala ikhasi elisha; okwangempela kuhlala endaweni yako.
bulk.linksHint: Irekhodi ngalinye lingasetha izixhumanisi ezihlukene kumbhalo okopishiwe, izithombe, noma amavidiyo. Amanani axhunyiwe angenalutho asusa isixhumanisi. Izendlalelo ezikhiyiwe zigcina izixhumanisi zazo zesifanekiso.
bulk.matchHint: Ifanisa amagama aphelele ngenkathi inganakile ukuthi uhlamvu lukhulu noma luncane, izikhala eziphindaphindiwe, o-hyphen kanye no-underscore. Ukuxhumana okusebenzayo okukhona nezindawo zombhalo kuyagcinwa. Okufanayo okungacacile kuhlala kungaxhunyiwe. Ukuxhumana kwezithombe kusebenzisa ukubheka isithombe esiqanjwe igama esikhona.
bulk.noText: Engeza isendlalelo sombhalo noma se-QR esingakhiyiwe kuleli khasi ukuze uxhume idatha yakho.
bulk.pageFieldsHint: La makholomu angakha amakhasi ngisho nangaphandle kwezingqimba zombhalo ezixhunyiwe. Amanothi angenalutho nezingxenye kusula lezo zikhala; eminye imidwebo ilandela ithempulethi.
bulk.pagePreviewHint: Ibonisa leli rekhodi ngombhalo wamanje, i-QR nokuxhumeka kwesithombe esinegama. Ukubuka kuqala akufaki amakhasi kumklamo wakho.
bulk.photosHint: Amanani ekholomu afana namagama esendlalelo sezithombe kulo mklamo. Amanani angenalutho agcina isithombe sethempulethi noma ifreyimu. Ukubekwa nesitayela kulandela ithempulethi; isithombe ngasinye somthombo esiqanjwe igama kufanele sitholakale kule divayisi.
bulk.title: Ukusungula ngobuningi
bulk.tokenHint: Namathisela indawo egciniwe (placeholder) embhalweni wesifanekiso noma kokuqukethwe kwe-QR bese ukhetha okuthi Sebenzisa izindawo ezigciniwe embhalweni waleyo ngqimba. Ukufometha kushiya amanani esipredishithi engashintshile. Amafomethi ezinombolo adinga izinombolo ezilula; u-25 ufomethwa njengo-25% kumodi yamaphesenti.

clipboard.empty: Khetha izendlalelo zangaphambili ezingakhiyiwe kuleli khasi

compositions.brandFontHint: Isebenzisa amafonti esihloko nomzimba alondoloziwe kuhlanganiso olusha. Imibala yombhalo neyokugqamisa isebenzisa izilawuli ezingenhla; imisebenzi yobuciko ekhona ihlala ezindaweni zayo.
compositions.heading: Isihloko
compositions.layoutFontsActive: Isakhiwo ngasinye sisebenzisa ukubhangqwa kwaso kwamafonti kwasekuqaleni.
compositions.limit: Lokhu kubhangqwa kudlula imikhawulo yezendlalelo noma yosayizi bomklamo.
compositions.noSavedFonts: Londoloza ifonti yesihloko noma yomzimba ezitayeleni ze-Brand ukuze uyisebenzise lapha.
compositions.previewHint: Buka kuqala ngombala wekhasi, ngaphandle komunye umsebenzi wobuciko. Faka ukubhangqwa okukhethiwe ukuze ungeze izendlalelo ezihlelekayo.
compositions.previewNeedsData: Faka isihloko nemibala ephelele ukuze ubuke kuqala lokhu kubhangqwa.
compositions.previewUnavailable: Ukubuka kuqala kukhanvasi akutholakali. Okusalungiswa kwakho kuseyikho okungahleleka.
compositions.subtitle: Umbhalo wokusekela
compositions.title: Izinhlanganisela zombhalo

connectors.hint: Shintsha usayizi, welula, jikisa, noma phendula isixhumi kukhanyensi. Sikhethe futhi ukuze uhlele indlela yaso nezindawo zokugcina.
connectors.title: Imigqa nezixhumi

crop.focusHint: Hambisa iwindi lokunqampuna ngenkathi ugcina usayizi walo.
crop.precisionHint: Izilinganiso zishintsha ukunqampuna ngenkathi kulondolozwa indawo ebonisiwe. Izindawo zokugxila zihambisa iwindi lokunqampuna elikhona phakathi kwemingcele yalo etholakalayo, okuhlanganisa nezithombe ezijikisiwe.
crop.touchHint: Hudula ukuze ubeke kabusha · finyeza ukuze usondeze

dataCells.actionRange: Ibanga lamaseli (lishiye lingenalutho kuwo wonke amaseli)
dataCells.invalidAddress: Khetha iseli elikhona phakathi kuka-A1 no-{{last}}
dataCells.numberCleanupHint: Ukuhlanzwa kwezinombolo kususa izimpawu zemali ezisekelwayo nezihlukanisi zamaqoqo, futhi kuguqule izinombolo ezingezinhle zokubalwa kwezimali. Amaphesenti ahlala engamaphuzu amaphesenti: u-25% uba ngu-25. Umbhalo ongaqashelwa uhlala unjalo. Izenzo zihlela amaseli omthombo ngenkathi kugcinwa ukufomethwa kwetafula kunamathele ezindaweni zamaseli.
dataCells.pasteHint: Namathisela imigqa evela kuspredishithi, i-CSV, noma i-TSV. Athatha indawo yebanga elingunxande eliqala kusele elikhethiwe; idatha ezungezile iyagcinwa.
dataCells.valueHint: Hlela iseli lonke lapha, okuhlanganisa nokwephuka komugqa. Amanani agcinwa njengombhalo; amafomula awabalwa.

dataVisual.captionHint: Isihloko nesichasiselo kuvela ngaphakathi kwesithombe nendawo ebekiwe ngenhla nangaphansi kwendawo. Izincazelo ze-SVG zihambisana nokuthekelisa kwe-vector; amanye amafomethi okuthekelisa agcina umbhalo obonakalayo. Chaza okutholakele okuyinhloko namanani afanele embhalweni ohlukile.
dataVisual.expandedHint: Izinguquko zihlala kudrafti efanayo nephaneli eseceleni. Vala lesi sihleli, bese ubuyekeza noma ufake isithombe ukuze usisebenzise ku-canvas.
dataVisual.fixSource: Sebenzisa idatha yoMthombo ukulungisa lokhu okufakiwe.
dataVisual.previewHint: Ukubuka kuqala idrafti kumbala wekhasi. Sebenzisa isithombe ukuze ulondoloze lezi zinguquko.
dataVisual.previewNeedsData: Faka idatha nemibala evumelekile ukuze ubuke kuqala isithombe.
dataVisual.previewUnavailable: Ukubuka kuqala kukhanvasi akutholakali. Okusalungiswa kwakho kusengahleleka.
dataVisual.singleSeriesViewHint: Leli chati likhombisa uchungechunge lokuqala lwedatha; olunye uchungechunge luhlala emthonjeni.
dataVisual.title: Amashadi namathebula
dataVisual.vectorHint: Kuthumela lesi sithombe ngemuva okusobala. Umbhalo uhlala uhleleka futhi usebenzisa ifonti ekhethiwe lapho itholakala khona.

designTools.colourHint: Khetha umbala ozowushintsha kulo lonke lolu hlelo. Izendlalelo ezikhiyiwe ziyagcinwa.

diagrams.editHint: I-node ngayinye nombhalo wayo kwakha iqembu. Amalebula okuxhuma ahlanganiswe ngemigqa yawo. Imigqa ihlala izixhumi ezihlukile ezilungisekayo; zibeke kabusha ngemva kokuhambisa ama-node. Amalebula angenalutho asebenzisa umbhalo wokuqalisa. Umdwebo ugcwalisa ubude bekhasi lamanje futhi ungagcinwa kulabhulali yakho yezinto ezingasetshenziswa kabusha.
diagrams.previewHint: Buka kuqala usebenzisa umbala wekhasi ngaphandle komunye umsebenzi wobuciko. Faka umdwebo ukuze ufake izingqimba ezilungisekayo.
diagrams.previewNeedsData: Qedela imibala bese usebenzisa amalebula e-node afinyelela ezinhlamvwini ezingu-120 ukuze ubuke kuqala.
diagrams.previewUnavailable: Ukubuka kusengaphambili kwe-canvas akutholakali. Okusalungiswayo kuhlala kungahlelwa.
diagrams.title: Iziqalo zomdwebo ezilungisekayo

document.numberHint: Faka izinombolo zekhasi ezilungisekayo. Ukubuyekezwa kwezinombolo lapho amakhasi efakwa, ephindwe kabili, esuswa, noma ehlelwa kabusha. Izinombolo ezikhiyiwe zihlala zingashintshiwe.
document.repeatHint: Khetha isihloko, umbhalo ongezansi, ilogo, noma umsebenzi wobuciko ukuze uwukopishe endaweni efanayo emakhasini akhethiwe. Ikhophi ngayinye ihlala ngokuzimela.
document.repeatScopeHint: Isebenzisa izinombolo zamakhasi edokhumenti. Ikhasi lamanje lihlale likhishelwa ngaphandle.
document.title: Izinombolo zamakhasi nezinto eziphindaphindwayo

elements.hint: Yonga umbhalo ongasetshenziswa kabusha ongaba ngu-20 nokukhethwa kwe-vector kule akhawunti kule divayisi. Amaqembu, ukufometha, nokubekwa kwamakhasi okuhlobene kugcinwa. Izithombe nokuhlala kwamavidiyo kumiklamo yawo yasekuqaleni.
elements.name: Igama le-Element
elements.proportionHint: Ilungisa ikhasi lomthombo ngokulinganayo ngaphakathi kwaleli khasi, igcine indawo ehlobene yomsebenzi wobuciko. Cisha ukuze usebenzise ukuhlelwa okuhlobene kwaleli khasi. Izakhi ezindala ezingenazo izilinganiso zomthombo zigcina ukuhlelwa kwazo okuhlobene.
elements.selectionLibrary: Gcina noma uphinde usebenzise izakhi ezikhethiwe
elements.title: Izakhi ezigciniwe

fills.heading: Ukugcwala nezizinda
fills.hint: Faka i-gradient emibhalweni noma ezimweni ezikhethiwe, noma uyifake ngemuva kwaleli khasi.
fills.lockedBackground: Ukungazibona ukuthethwa kwamaphepha kwenkos' ukhethwa ngayo.

fonts.count: {{count}} amafonti atholakele. Sesha ukuze unciphise uhlu.
fonts.graphicCoverage: Kuhlanganisa izingqimba zombhalo, amashadi namatafula. Izendlalelo ezikhiyiwe zigcina amafonti azo.
fonts.replaceDesign: Shintsha ifonti kulo lonke lolu hlelo lokuklama

gradients.brandPaletteHint: Kulayisha imibala yephalethi kudrafti ye-gradient enezitobhi ezingacacile, ezinezikhala ezilinganayo. Amagradient asebenzisa imibala efinyelela kwayisishiyagalombili; amaphelethi amakhulu agcina izindawo zawo zokugcina futhi asampula imibala ephakathi kwawo.
gradients.invalid: Sebenzisa imibala ephelele ye-hex enamadijithi ayisithupha kuzo zonke izitobhi.
gradients.noBrandPalettes: Londoloza iphalethi okungenani enemibala emibili ngezitayela zeBrand ukuze uyisebenzise lapha.
gradients.styleFileHint: Idlulisela imibala ye-gradient, izikhundla, ukucaca, i-engeli namasethingi emisebe phakathi kwamadivayisi. Ngenisa ilayisha okusalungiswa; yisebenzise ukuze ubuyekeze ubuciko.
gradients.svgHint: Ithumela lo mbala oshintshayo (gradient) ngosayizi wekhasi, kuhlanganise nezindawo zokumisa kanye nokukhanya. Wusebenzise ngokwehlukana ukuze uwusebenzise ekwakhiweni.

grids.mobileHint: Faka isakhiwo sesithombe. Thepha uhlaka bese ukhetha u-Replace selected layer ukuze ulugcwalise ngesithombe noma ividiyo.
grids.title: Amagridi ezithombe

groups.hint: Khetha izingqimba ukuze uzihambise, uzishintshe usayizi, uzijikelezise, futhi uzikopishe ndawonye.
groups.matchSizeHint: Ilinganisa ingqimba ngayinye noma iqoqo ngokwesikhungo sayo futhi igcina izilinganiso. Izilinganiso zihlanganisa ukujikeleza. Ibhokisi lesikhombo elilinganisiwe lisebenzisa usayizi omkhulu kakhulu olingana nobukhulu bobubili; okukhulu kakhulu nokuncane kakhulu kuqhathanisa indawo yebhokisi lale nketho. Izitayela zombhalo nemivimbo ziyalinganiseka nomsebenzi wobuciko.

guides.hint: Hudula usuka kurula ukuze ungeze umhlahlandlela. Khetha Hlela imihlahlandlela ukuze uhambise imihlahlandlela, noma uyihudule uyikhiphe ekhasini ukuze uyisuse. Imihlahlandlela nemingcele ayifakiwe ekulandweni.
guides.title: Imihlahlandlela nemingcele

help.noResults: Ayikho usizo olufanayo. Zama igama lethuluzi noma isenzo esifana nokunamathisela, ukunqampuna, noma ukuhlela eqenjini.
help.title: Umhlahlandlela womhleli

links.contactBuilder: Yakha isixhumanisi se-imeyili, ifoni noma i-SMS
links.copyFailed: Kuhlulekile ukukopisha indawo okuyiwa kuyo kwisixhumanisi
links.hint: Ukudawuniloda kwe-PDF kugcina iwebhu, i-imeyili, ucingo, i-SMS namalinki ekhasi. Ukusingathwa kwesixhumanisi sokuxhumana kuncike ekubukeni nasedivayisini. Thumela amakhasi endawo oya kuyo ukuze ugcine amalinki angaphakathi esebenza.
links.mixed: Imidwebo ekhethiwe inezindawo ezixubile zelinki. Sebenzisa indawo oya kuyo ukuze uyinikeze ilinki efanayo.
links.title: Ilinki

mediaSelection.filterHint: Faka esikhundleni sokulungiswa kombala nokufiphala ezithombeni namavidiyo akhethiwe ekuhleleni okukodwa. Sika, amafreyimu, imingcele kanye nokuhlala kwesikhathi.
mediaSelection.radiusHint: Ukuzungeza kwekona kusebenza ezinhlakeni zemidiya ezingunxande.
mediaSelection.title: Hlela izithombe namavidiyo akhethiwe ({{count}})

mockups.caption: Ikheli noma isihlokwana sesithombe (akuphoqelekile)
mockups.editHint: Ifaka iqoqo lezimo ezihlelekayo kanye nohlaka lwesithombe kuleli khasi. Isithombe esikopishiwe sigcina imiphumela yaso kanye nephuzu eligxilwe kulo nge-Fill screen, noma sigcine ukunqampuna kwaso kwamanje nge-Fit photo. Isithombe sokuqala sihlala endaweni yaso. Khetha isikrini ukuze ushintshe isithombe saso; hlukanisa iqoqo ukuze uhlele imininingwane yohlaka ngayinye.
mockups.emptyScreen: Khetha isithombe esisodwa esivuliwe ukuze ugcwalise i-mockup, noma ufake isikrini esingenalutho bese usishintsha kamuva.
mockups.fitHint: Gcwalisa isikrini ukuze silingane nohlaka. Ukulinganisa isithombe kugcina ukunqampuna kwesithombe okukhethiwe njengoba kunjalo futhi kukhombisa ingemuva lesikrini elikuzungezile.
mockups.noPalettes: Londoloza iphalethi ezitayeleni zomkhiqizo (Brand styles) ukuze uyisebenzise lapha.
mockups.paletteHint: Imibala emithathu yokuqala ibeka okokwakha uhlaka, imininingwane kanye nengemuva lesikrini. Imibala engekho igcina amanani ayo amanje. Iphalethi elondoloziwe igcina le mibala yohlaka ezitayeleni zomkhiqizo.
mockups.placementHint: I-mockup yonke iyazungeza ndawonye futhi ilingana ngaphakathi kwaleli phesenti lekhasi. Izimo zayo, isithombe kanye nombhalo osezansi kuhlala kuhleleka njengeqembu.
mockups.previewHint: Ukubuka kuqala kukhombisa i-mockup ngaphandle kweminye imisebenzi yobuciko. Ukuyifaka kwengeza izingqimba ezihlelekayo ekhasini lamanje.
mockups.previewNeedsData: Qedela imibala yohlaka ukuze ubuke kuqala.
mockups.previewUnavailable: Ukubuka kuqala akutholakali. Izilungiselelo zohlaka zihlala zihleleka.
mockups.title: Amamockup wedivayisi nawokuphrinta

notes.changed: Leli khasi lishintshile. Vula kabusha Amanothi ngaphambi kokulondoloza.
notes.hint: Amagama namanothi alondolozwa nalo mklamo. Awaveli ezithombeni, kumavidiyo, noma ekukhishweni kwe-PDF.
notes.name: Igama lekhasi
notes.title: Amanothi ekhasini

orientation.hint: Isendlalelo ngasinye esikhethiwe sithola i-engeli efanayo endaweni yaso ekhona. Ukuzungezisa okuhlobene ngezansi kuphendula ukukhetha ndawonye.
orientation.title: Setha ukuma kwesendlalelo

pageAnimation.hint: Sebenzisa ukunyakaza kokungena noma kokuphuma okuhleliwe ekhasini noma ekukhetheni. Izendlalelo ezikhiyiwe nezifihliwe zihlala zingashintshile. Izithombe nama-PDF asakhipha umsebenzi wobuciko ophelele.
pageAnimation.title: Nyakazisa ikhasi
pageAnimation.typewriterHint: Umbhalo uyathayipha; ezinye izendlalelo ziyaphela. Ubude besikhathi buhambisana nesikhathi sesendlalelo ngasinye.

pageManager.previewFailed: Okunye ukubuka kuqala akutholakali. Amakhasi asengavulwa.
pageManager.search: Thola amakhasi ngegama, inombolo, noma isihloko
pageManager.title: Lawula amakhasi

palette.chooseTarget: Khetha umbala wedokhumenti kuqala ukuze usebenzise i-swatch esikhundleni sayo.
palette.extractionHint: Sampula ikhasi lamanje, okuhlanganisa izithombe. Khetha i-swatch njengombala wokufaka esikhundleni, noma usebenzise iphalethi emibalabala engashintshwa kuwo wonke umklamo.
palette.presetLimit: Izikhala zakho zesitayela sebhrendi ezingu-20 zigcwele. Susa isitayela esilondoloziwe ngaphambi kokufaka iphalethi.

photoBackground.mobileHint: Khetha isithombe ozosisebenzisa ngemuva kwaleli khasi. Thepha kabili isizinda ukuze usifake kabusha, noma usihlukanise njengesendlalelo esinyakaziswayo.
photoBackground.unavailable: Isithombe asikwazanga ukushintshwa. Hlola izizinda ezikhiyiwe nomkhawulo wesendlalelo somklamo.

photoLooks.batchHint: Faka isicelo ku-{{count}} izithombe namavidiyo akhethiwe ekuhleleni okukodwa. Ukulondoloza kusebenzisa izinguquko zesendlalelo sokuqala esikhethiwe.
photoLooks.hint: Igcinwe nge-akhawunti ngayinye kule divayisi. Ukusebenzisa ukubukeka kuthatha indawo yombala, ukufiphala kanye nokulungiswa kwemininingwane. Sika, ifreyimu, imingcele kanye nokuhlala kwesikhathi. Ngenisa ukubukeka ukuze uyisebenzise, bese uyigcina emtatsheni wakho wezincwadi.
photoLooks.memoryOnly: Iyatholakala kulesi seshini; isitoreji sedivayisi asikwazanga ukusigcina
photoLooks.name: Bheka igama
photoLooks.saved: Umtapo wokubuka isithombe ubuyekeziwe kule divayisi
photoLooks.styleFileHint: Ukudluliselwa kombala, ukufiphala, i-duotone kanye nokulungiswa kwemininingwane phakathi kwamadivayisi. Ukungenisa kubonisa igama layo eligciniwe; lisebenzise esikhundleni sezinguquko zemidiya ezikhethiwe. Sika, amafreyimu, imingcele kanye nokuhlala kwesikhathi.
photoLooks.title: Izithombe ezilondoloziwe zibukeka

photos.arrangeHint: Ozimele, izikhundla, isitayela, namaqembu kuhlala ezindaweni zawo. Izindawo okugxilwe kuzo ezithombeni zilandela imithombo yazo. Izizinda nezithombe ezihlanganisa amakhasi amaningana azifakiwe.
photos.needFrames: Engeza okungenani izithombe ezimbili ezingakhiyiwe kuleli khasi ukuze uzihlele kabusha.

present.allHidden: Wonke amakhasi afihliwe. Ibonisa ikhasi lokuqala lalesi sethulo.
present.nextPreviewHint: Ukubuka kuqala kuphela. Sebenzisa Okulandelayo ukuze uye kuleli khasi.
present.rehearsalHint: Ukuvakashela kuqoqeka ngekhasi ngalinye. Isikhathi siyama ngenkathi uhlelo lokusebenza lungemuva, amakhasi elayisha, noma isikhethi sekhasi sivuliwe. Misa isikhashana ngaphambi kokusebenzisa; izikhathi zamakhasi angakavakashelwa zihlala zingashintshile.
present.title: Yethula amakhasi

qr.brandPaletteHint: Ikhetha umbala omnyama wangaphambili nombala okhanyayo wangemuva kusuka kuphalethi, isebenzisa okumnyama noma okumhlophe lapho kudingeka umehluko omkhulu. Iphalethi elondoloziwe igcina imibala yamanje ye-QR; okuqukethwe okubhalwe ngekhodi kuhlala kungashintshile.
qr.calendarHint: Imicimbi enesikhathi isebenzisa i-UTC; izinhlelo zokusebenza zekhalenda ziyibonisa endaweni yesikhathi yomamukeli. Izinsuku zosuku lonke zifaka nosuku lokugcina. Ukusekelwa kwesikena kuyahlukahluka; ifayela lekhalenda lingangeniswa ngqo.
qr.contactHint: Idala oxhumana naye we-vCard. Ukuskena kungase kuphakamise ukulondoloza le mininingwane; ukuziphatha kuncike kusikena.
qr.downloadCalendarHint: Londoloza umcimbi ofanayo njengefayela lekhalenda elingenisekayo.
qr.downloadContactHint: Londoloza imininingwane efanayo yoxhumana naye njengefayela lencwadi yakho yamakheli.
qr.failed: Sebenzisa umbhalo omfushane nemibala emibili ehlukene ye-hex.
qr.hint: Dala ikhodi ye-QR yesixhumanisi noma umbhalo. Gcina umehluko oqinile phakathi kwangaphambili nangemuva.
qr.noBrandPalettes: Londoloza iphalethi yombala ezitayeleni ze-Brand ukuze uyisebenzise lapha.
qr.smsHint: Ivula okusalungiswa komlayezo kumadivayisi asekelwayo. Ukusekelwa komamukeli nomlayezo ogcwaliswe ngaphambili kuncike kuhlelo lokusebenza.
qr.title: Ikhodi ye-QR

svgPath.hint: Namathisela idatha yomzila d noma uphawu oluyisisekelo lwe-SVG olunemizila, unxande, imibuthano, ama-ellipses, imigqa namapholigoni. Imiyalo yokuhambisa, yomugqa, ye-cubic, ye-quadratic, ebushelelezi neye-arc iyasekelwa. I-SVG matrix, ukuhumusha, ukukala, ukujikeleza nokuguqula i-skew kugcina i-geometry yayo. I-geometry isebenzisa umbala oyikhethile; upende wasekuqaleni, unhlangothi kanye nemingcele yokubuka akungeniswa. Amajika aba amasampula ezindawo zokudweba. Vala indlela ngo-Z ukuze uyigcwalise. Izakhi ezihlukene ze-SVG ezivaliwe zingagcwaliswa ndawonye. Izingxenye eziningi ziba izingqimba ezilungisekayo eziqoqiwe; izimbobo eziyinhlanganisela azisekelwa.

svgPath.title: Ngenisa i-geometry ye-SVG ekwazi ukuhlela

tables.brandPaletteHint: Isebenzisa umbala wephalethi ogciniwe wokuqala wesihloko, nemingcele ehambisanayo, imivimbo ecashile kanye nombhalo omnyama noma omhlophe ozenzakalelayo. Ukugcwaliswa komzimba nezitayela zamaseli ezenziwe ngokwezifiso kuhlala endaweni. Iphalethi yokulondoloza igcina imibala yethebula yamanje.
tables.cellStyleHint: Faka iseli noma ibanga ukuze ubhale phezu kwetimu yethebula. Setha kabusha amaseli ukuze ubuyisele ukubukeka okuzenzakalelayo kwethebula.

find.hint: Ukushintsha nokuhlanza kusebenzisa uhla olukhethiwe, noma wonke amaseli uma kungenalutho, kuyilapho kugcinwa ukufomethwa kweseli. Buyekeza isithombe ukuze usebenzise okusalungiswa; Hlehlisa kubuyisela ukuhlela okusetshenzisiwe.

tables.findReplace: Thola futhi ufake esikhundleni umbhalo wethebula
tables.fitColumnsHint: Ububanzi bulandela umbhalo weseli ongahlanganisiwe njengoba idatha ishintsha, ngaphakathi kwemingcele elinganiselayo. Ithebula ligcina usayizi walo uwonke. Ukushintsha usayizi wekholomu ngesandla kuyakucisha lokhu.
tables.fitRowsHint: Imigqa yabelana ngokuphakama kwethebula ngokombhalo wayo, ukugcwalisa nokusonga. Amaseli ahlanganisa imigqa eminingana awuthinti usayizi. Ukushintsha usayizi womugqa ngesandla kuyakucisha lokhu.
tables.fitTextHint: Iseli ngalinye lingancipha liye ku-35% wusayizi wombhalo okhethiwe. Umbhalo usasebenzisa amachashazi amathathu uma ungalingani; ukusonga kusekela imigqa efinyelela kwesishiyagalombili.
tables.mergeHint: Amaseli ahlanganisiwe abonisa iseli eliphezulu kwesobunxele. Okuqukethwe kumaseli amboziwe kugcinwa futhi kuphinde kuvele uma kungafakwanga.
tables.noBrandPalettes: Londoloza iphalethi yombala ngezitayela zeBrand ukuze uyisebenzise lapha.
tables.replaceOverrides: Setha kabusha izitayela zamaseli aqokiwe lapho ufaka isicelo
tables.rowCleanup: Susa imigqa engenalutho noma ephindwe kabili
tables.rowCleanupHint: Umugqa wesihloko ugcinwa. Ukuhlanza okuphindaphindiwe kugcina umugqa wokuqala ofanayo futhi kulondoloza izitayela zamaseli ezisele nosayizi womugqa. Umbhalo uqhathaniswa ngaphandle kokuwushintsha. Amatafula agcina okungenani umugqa owodwa; amangqamuzana angahlanganisiwe anemigqa ngaphambi kokuhlanza.
tables.scaleHint: Faka imibala yamangqamuzana ezinombolo ebangeni elikhethiwe. Amaseli angenalutho, athumelelana imiyalezo namaseli ahlanganisiwe agcina izitayela zawo. Faka isicelo futhi ngemva kokushintsha izinombolo.
tables.starterHint: Isiqalo sithatha indawo yale datha yetafula lokusungula nokufometha. Ikhanva yakho yamanje iyashintsha kuphela uma ubuyekeza noma ufaka isithombe. Isibonelo samanani nengqikithi yizindinganiso ezilungisekayo; azibalwa kabusha ngokuzenzakalelayo.
tables.structureHint: Ukufometha amaseli nosayizi ohlobene kulandela imigqa namakholomu awo. Izihloko zihlala emgqeni wokuqala noma kukholomu.
tables.styleFileHint: Ukudlulisela ukubukeka namaphalethi phakathi kwamadivayisi. Okuqukethwe, ukuhlanganiswa kanye nokufometha amaseli ngokwezifiso ukuhlala etafuleni lendawo oya kuyo. Amasethingi afaneleka ngokuzenzakalelayo angashintsha usayizi obonisiwe.
tables.stylePreserveHint: Izitayela zigcina okusunguliwe kwakho, amaseli ahlanganisiwe, nosayizi womugqa nekholomu.
tables.summaryHint: Ibala ikholomu ngayinye ngokwehlukana. Amangqamuzana angenalutho futhi angenazinombolo ayeqiwa. Umugqa ohlanganisiwe uqukethe izinombolo ezingaguquki; bala kabusha ngemva kokushintsha amanani omthombo.
tables.weightsHint: Osayizi bahlobene. Inani elingu-2 lisebenzisa indawo ephindwe kabili kunelingu-1; itafula ligcina usayizi walo uwonke.
